skill.name: gemini-computer-use
skill.description: Run Gemini Computer Use browser agents with Playwright for supervised web automation and UI testing workflows.
skill.summary: Control a Playwright browser through Gemini Computer Use with safety prompts and configurable limits.
skill.author: am-will

security_audit.summary: Static findings for secret placeholders, Markdown backticks, and keyboard keys are mostly false positives after context review. The material risks are semantic: browser screenshots are sent to Gemini, and model directed browser actions execute without a local allowlist or mandatory confirmation.

remediation.issue: Browser screenshots and current URLs are sent to Gemini during the loop.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to use authenticated sessions. Add optional screenshot confirmation, redaction, and a domain allowlist before sending page content.

remediation.issue: Model requested browser actions execute unless a model supplied safety decision asks for confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Add local policy checks for navigation, clicks, text entry, and key combinations. Require confirmation for risky actions by default.

remediation.issue: The environment template asks users to store a Gemini API key in a sourced shell file.
remediation.suggestion: Document that env.sh must stay uncommitted. Recommend short lived keys or a secrets manager for shared environments.

semantic_findings.title: Browser Screenshot Exposure to External Model
semantic_findings.description: The script sends the current browser URL and screenshots to Gemini during the agent loop. Sensitive page content can leave the local environment if users run it on authenticated pages.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code builds function responses with current_url and screenshot bytes, then calls the Gemini model with screenshot content. This is expected behavior but creates a clear data exposure risk.

semantic_findings.title: Model Directed Browser Actions Need Local Guardrails
semantic_findings.description: The script executes model requested navigation, clicks, typing, and key presses. Local confirmation only happens when the model includes a safety decision.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The action dispatcher performs browser actions directly after parsing model function calls. The only confirmation gate depends on a model supplied safety_decision field.

content.user_title: Automate Browser Tasks with Gemini Computer Use
content.value_statement: Browser automation with multimodal models is hard to wire safely. This skill provides a Playwright agent loop for Gemini Computer Use with setup guidance and safety controls.
actual_capabilities: Creates a Gemini Computer Use loop that sends screenshots and receives function calls.
Runs browser actions through Playwright, including navigation, clicks, typing, scrolling, and drag actions.
Supports prompt, start URL, turn limit, viewport size, headless mode, and excluded actions.
Reads a Gemini API key from the environment for Google GenAI client authentication.
Supports Playwright browser channel or executable selection through environment variables.
Prompts the user when a model supplied safety decision requires confirmation.
limitations: Requires a Gemini API key, Python, Playwright, and installed browser dependencies.
Sends browser screenshots and current URLs to the Gemini model during operation.
Does not include a domain allowlist, credential redaction, or production policy engine.
Only supports browser environment actions exposed by Gemini Computer Use.

use_cases.title: Prototype Browser Agents
use_cases.description: Build a working Gemini Computer Use loop before investing in a larger automation service.

use_cases.title: Test Public Web Workflows

use_cases.title: Evaluate Safety Controls

prompt_templates.title: Run a Simple Public Page Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a low risk public website.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Gemini Computer Use skill to open a public website and report the main page title. Keep the turn limit low.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a Controlled Test Run
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate browser run with a chosen start URL and exclusions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up a Playwright Gemini Computer Use run for this public test URL. Exclude text entry and keep the browser visible.

prompt_templates.title: Review Agent Safety Before Running
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of action risks before browser automation starts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the planned Gemini Computer Use command. Identify actions that should require confirmation and suggest safe exclude settings.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt the Loop for a Test Harness
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced integration work for repeatable browser tests.
prompt_templates.prompt: Modify the agent loop design for repeatable public site tests with logging, domain limits, and mandatory confirmation for text entry.

output_examples.input: Find the headline on a public documentation page.
output_examples.output: The agent opens the page, sends a screenshot to Gemini, follows returned browser actions, and reports the visible headline.

output_examples.input: Run a browser task with text entry excluded.
output_examples.output: The run starts with text entry disabled. Navigation and reading can continue, but the agent cannot type into forms.

output_examples.input: Review whether a proposed task is safe for Computer Use.
output_examples.output: The review flags authenticated pages, sensitive forms, and unbounded navigation as risks before the browser session starts.

best_practices: Use a fresh browser profile with no personal accounts or saved credentials.
Start with a low turn limit and exclude risky actions until the workflow is understood.
Review screenshots and target domains before sending sensitive page content to a model.
anti_patterns: Running the agent inside a logged in browser session that contains private data.
Allowing unrestricted text entry or key combinations on payment, account, or admin pages.
Treating model supplied safety decisions as the only approval gate for risky actions.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It automates a Playwright browser using Gemini Computer Use function calls and screenshots.

faq.question: Does it need a Gemini API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The script reads GEMINI_API_KEY from the environment before it creates the GenAI client.

faq.question: Can I choose the browser?
faq.answer: Yes. You can use Playwright Chromium, a browser channel, or a Chromium based executable path.

faq.question: Does it send screenshots outside my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. Screenshots and the current URL are sent to Gemini as part of the Computer Use loop.

faq.question: How can I reduce risky actions?
faq.answer: Use the exclude option, keep the turn limit low, and require local confirmation for sensitive steps.

faq.question: Is this production ready by itself?
faq.answer: No. Add domain restrictions, auditing, redaction, and stronger local policy checks before production use.
